title: On Trainers, the keyboard ring vanishes on the booking grid, member picks, bookings and working days
what: The free and booked times in the trainers' week grid, the member list in Book a session, a trainer's bookings and the working-day buttons are made with all their look wiped, which also wipes the ring that shows where the keyboard is. A keyboard user tabbing through cannot see which time or day they are on.
expected: Every button shows a clear ring when reached with the keyboard, like the rest of the panel's buttons and tap rows.
who: owners and desk staff using a keyboard on a computer
fix_line: Give these buttons the panel's own focus ring class, or stop wiping the browser's ring

title: Some things on these pages are smaller to tap than the panel's own finger-size rule
what: The Free and booked times in the trainers' week grid are 36 points tall, the working-day buttons on a trainer's profile are 40, and the member name links on Member messages, Member questions and Training progress are only as tall as the text. The panel's rule is 44.
expected: Every tappable thing is at least 44 points tall so a thumb hits it first time.
who: owners, desk staff and trainers on a phone
fix_line: Raise these to the 44-point size the rest of the panel uses

title: On Today, a screen reader hears 'Message' on every person row with no name
what: Each person row on Today has a 'Message' link that opens WhatsApp. Its spoken name is only 'Message', so a screen reader user going through the links hears 'Message, Message, Message' and cannot tell who each one is for. The renew list's own Message button on the same page does say the member's name.
expected: Each link says who it messages, for example 'Message Riya Sharma on WhatsApp'.
who: owners and desk staff using a screen reader
fix_line: Add the member's name to each Message link's spoken label

title: On Today, a person's name opens their page but looks like plain text
what: In Today's lists, the member's picture, name and status line open the member's page, but they carry no underline, arrow or frame. A first-time owner sees only the orange 'Message' as something to tap and may not know the name opens the member.
expected: A row that opens something shows it, for example with the arrow or the firm-up frame other panel rows use.
fix_line: Give the name part of each row the panel's tap-row look with an arrow

items.reason: Most buttons are the kit's 44px ones with names (edit, move, remove, open), photos have alt text, file pickers and the batch filter have labels, CANCELLED and classes-left colours come with words, the PT grid has a written key. Faults: Trainers' hand-made buttons lose the focus ring and some are under 44, Today's Message links have no name, tiny fixed px text (already reported). Largest phone font not checkable without a phone; axe crawl (dark only) reports 0 serious.

No screenshot of these pages was opened; judged from code. More rows have icon, hint and arrow; member name links keep the underline. Today's name rows look like plain text; Collect on Dues, Copy and Withdraw on Workout plans use the grey text-look button already reported.

'Not now' on the web page step leaves a button to bring it back; confirm pop-ups only cancel. But the workout plan builder, trainer profile, plan and workout-of-the-day forms close on the cross or Escape and lose all typing with no question (same kit fault already reported).
